cause: Native guest leaves 177662 unread; keymap retains a second character and stops consuming PS/2 scan FIFO, blocking STOP and break codes.
fix: Always consume native scan frames and update physical state; discard extra character makes when the BK register is occupied. Preserve BIOS ordered ready/valid input.
reference: ../20261005-ay/bkbtl-board.cpp: CMotherboard::KeyboardEvent processes STOP/release independently and ignores characters while the ready bit is set.
